2026-10-22-pif:
Could you show an inspector your Product Information File today? 🔍

Your PIF must contain:
✔ Product description
✔ Cosmetic Product Safety Report (CPSR)
✔ Manufacturing method + GMP statement
✔ Proof of label claims
✔ Animal testing data

It must be kept for 10 years after the last batch is sold.

2026-10-23-label:
Is your cosmetic label legally compliant? 🏷️

Under UK and EU rules your label must show:
✔ Responsible Person name and address
✔ Nominal content (ml or g)
✔ Best-before date or PAO symbol
✔ Batch number
✔ Full INCI ingredient list, including labelled allergens

Label mistakes are one of the most common reasons products are withdrawn.

2026-10-24-scpn-cpnp:
SCPN or CPNP: which one do you need? 🤔

🇬🇧 Great Britain → SCPN
🇪🇺 EU countries → CPNP
🇬🇧 Northern Ireland → CPNP
🌍 Selling in both → you need both

2026-10-25-rp:
What is a Responsible Person? 👤

Every cosmetic in the UK and EU must have one. They:
✔ Are your legal contact for regulators
✔ Keep your PIF and CPSR on file
✔ Notify your products (SCPN / CPNP)
✔ Appear on your product label

Based outside the UK or EU? We can act as your Responsible Person.
